invariant_owner_layer.why: chunkBoundary owns retry/cooldown; NomiStudioApp owns preserving the project target before reload.

problem_type: Dynamic renderer chunk failure leaves project hydration on the library route
symptom: In the v0.23.0 project-open path, a stale, missing, or transient renderer chunk can make clicking a project return to the library with no route that retries the same project.
direct_cause: NomiStudioApp dynamically imports projectPersistenceService during hydrateProject. The import was outside the shared chunk retry/reload boundary; its rejection was caught as a generic project restore failure and returned false, while the library URL remained project-free.
class_root: Every dynamic renderer chunk used by project opening must either recover once in the current document or preserve the project target across one bounded renderer reload; otherwise a chunk failure is indistinguishable from a dead project card.
affected_population: v0.23.0 installs with a stale renderer index or missing projectPersistenceService chunk
Any platform where an asar/filesystem read transiently rejects a dynamic import
Projects opened from the library, including native and folder-backed projects
internal_only_reason: The invariant is owned entirely by the renderer's chunk loader and project hydration flow; no third-party behavior is required to decide the recovery contract.
invariants: A transient dynamic-import failure is retried twice before surfacing.
A project-open chunk failure preserves the target projectId in the URL before reloading.
The reload is session-cooldown bounded, so a permanently missing asset cannot loop forever.
Non-chunk hydration errors keep the existing visible project restore failure path.

door_reduction.why_not: These are independent dynamic-import consumers. The fix centralizes retry/cooldown behavior in chunkBoundary but does not remove or merge unrelated lazy surfaces; each remains responsible for its own UI boundary.

generality_proof: All checked dynamic renderer imports converge on importWithRetry/isChunkLoadNetworkError/scheduleChunkReload, while projectPersistenceLoader now uses importWithRetry and NomiStudioApp preserves the project route before a bounded reload. A future chunk consumer that uses lazyWithChunkBoundary inherits the same cooldown behavior; a project-open failure cannot silently lose its target URL.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own retry cooldown and one bounded renderer reload for dynamic chunk failures.
Load the project persistence/migration chunk through importWithRetry.
Preserve the projectId route before scheduling recovery so the next document retries the same project.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: This is the dynamic import that gates every library project hydration and now calls importWithRetry.
All existing React.lazy surfaces already share importWithRetry and now share scheduleChunkReload cooldown semantics.
Persistence/migration failures after the module loads remain ordinary hydration errors and keep the visible recovery/diagnose path; this change does not swallow them.

recurrence.reason: Chunk hashes change on every production build and filesystem/asar reads can fail transiently, so another project or lazy surface can encounter the same class.
same_class_scan: rg lazyWithChunkBoundary src across router, workbench, canvas, preview, settings, and explorer

prevention.invariant: A chunk failure gets bounded retry/reload behavior, and project opening preserves its target route before recovery.
prevention.failure_mode: After retries and one cooldown-bounded reload, the existing localized project restore error is shown; no project is deleted or silently replaced.
prevention.strategy: Route every project persistence chunk import through importWithRetry and use the shared session cooldown for reload recovery.

legacy_paths.rationale: The direct loader is replaced by projectPersistenceLoader; no fallback import path remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls the application-level route/retry invariant.

migration: No persisted project schema changes. A failed open reloads the renderer with the same projectId query parameter and retries the existing hydration path.
residual_risks: This environment has no DISPLAY/Xvfb, so a real Electron click-through on v0.23.0 cannot be executed here.
A permanently missing packaged chunk still requires the existing visible restore error after the cooldown-bounded reload; packaging integrity remains a separate release gate.
